evals.prompt: Our Flutter project resolves mix 2.4.0. A panel applies BoxStyler().padding(.all(12)) in a separate statement but its child still touches the edge. Explain what to check and show a widget test that distinguishes 12 logical pixels from zero.
evals.expected_output: Find whether the result of padding was discarded or never supplied to the actual Box, and test the resulting inset.
expectations: Traces which Box receives the modified style and preserves the returned styler.
Measures the laid-out inset of the child against the parent in a focused widget test.

evals.prompt: Our Flutter app uses Mix from a local path override. A docs example uses a method our analyzer does not recognize. Change the widget's design token to show a different color in one subtree.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the package path, use its actual API, scope the token override to the requested subtree and check an unaffected sibling.
expectations: Checks the resolved local package before choosing an API.
Localizes the change to the subtree and verifies both affected and unaffected widgets.
